title: Tension on A
description: Essential: Correctly states the tension on block A as T = mg (or equivalent expression mg(sinθ + μ cosθ) with correct numerical substitution).

title: External Force F
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnitude of the external force as F = 4mg (or equivalent expression with correct numerical substitution).

title: Force Balance on A
description: Important: Applies equilibrium to block A, balancing tension against the sum of the component of gravity down the incline and the static friction force (which acts down the incline).

title: Force Balance on B
description: Important: Applies equilibrium to block B, setting the component of F up the incline equal to the sum of gravity down the incline, friction down the incline, and tension down the incline.

title: Normal Force on B
description: Important: Correctly calculates the normal force on block B as N_B = mg cosθ + F sinθ.

title: Friction Direction
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the direction of the friction forces on A or B as up the incline instead of down (since motion is impending upwards).

title: Sign/Substitution Error
description: Pitfall: Makes a numerical or algebraic error when substituting sin37°=0.6, cos37°=0.8, or μ=0.5 into the equilibrium equations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Expresses final answers in terms of mg with correct units implied, or explicitly includes the gravitational acceleration g.
